bib.title: Making the V in VQA Matter: Elevating the Role of Image Understanding in Visual Question Answering

question: Do VQA models exploit language priors rather than the image, and can a balanced dataset with complementary image pairs force them to use vision?
hypothesis: A balanced dataset in which each question has two similar images with different answers will force VQA models to focus on visual information.
contributions: Balance the VQA dataset by collecting complementary images so each question has a pair of similar images with different answers (about twice the size).
Benchmark state-of-art VQA models trained on the unbalanced set on the balanced set, showing they exploit language priors.
A counter-example explanation model that answers and retrieves a similar image it believes has a different answer.

method.summary: AMT workers pick, from the 24 fc7-nearest-neighbour COCO images, one image where the question makes sense but the answer differs; 10 new answers are collected for it. Three existing VQA models plus Prior and Language-only baselines are trained and tested on unbalanced and balanced splits; a two-head model adds counter-example retrieval trained with a pairwise hinge ranking loss.
method.task: visual question answering (open-ended) and counter-example explanation retrieval

datasets.name: VQA v1 real images (Antol et al.)
datasets.size: just over 204K COCO images, 614K questions (3 per image), over 6 million answers (10 per question)

datasets.name: Balanced VQA / VQA v2.0 (this work)
datasets.size: about 1.1 million (image, question) pairs, about 13 million answers, about 200k images; more than 443K train, 214K val, 453K test pairs; about 195K / 93K / 191K complementary images for train/val/test; about 18K extra test pairs
datasets.split: test split into test-dev, test-standard, test-challenge, test-reserve; Bhalf = balanced train subset of similar size to original; Table 2 uses train+val
datasets.source: AMT annotation on COCO; public at visualqa.org
datasets.preprocessing: 24 nearest neighbours by l2 distance on VGGNet fc7; 'not possible' option chosen for about 135K questions (22% of questions)

models.name: d-LSTM+n-I (Deeper LSTM Question + norm Image)
models.architecture: CNN image embedding x LSTM question embedding (point-wise product), MLP over 1000 most frequent answers; VGGNet features

models.name: HieCoAtt
models.architecture: hierarchical co-attention (word, phrase, question level), 1000 answers; VGGNet features

models.name: MCB
models.architecture: multimodal compact bilinear pooling with attention, 3000 answers; ResNet features

models.name: Counter-example explanation model
models.architecture: shared trunk (image CNN x question LSTM, point-wise product) with answering head (FC + softmax) and explaining head (inner product of linear embeddings of QI and answer, FC to K scores); 25 images through trunk

training.objective: L = -log P(A|I,Q) + lambda * sum_i max(0, M - (S(I') - S(I_i))) (explanation model); benchmarked models use their own published objectives

inference.samples: single run per cell; no seeds or variance reported
inference.retrieval: counter-example chosen from K=24 nearest neighbours of I; ranked by learned score

metrics.name: VQA accuracy
metrics.definition: public VQA evaluation script using 10 ground-truth answers per question

metrics.name: Recall@5 (explanation)
metrics.definition: how often the human-picked I' is among the top-5 of the sorted 24 neighbours

eval.protocol: Train/test on unbalanced (U) or balanced (B) sets: UU, UB, BhalfB, BB; v2.0 test-standard after train+val. No significance tests.

availability.code: benchmarked models use public code; no code for the new model stated

limits: Balancing is not perfect: authors say the dataset is 'not perfectly balanced'.
'Not possible' selections cover 22% of questions (about 135K), so some questions get no complementary image.
About 9% of pairs end with the same majority answer.
Human-picked counter-example is not unique or 'best'; Recall@5 is an approximation.
No hyperparameters, optimisers, seeds or variance reported for any model.
Distance baseline (42.84) nearly matches the proposed explanation model (43.39).
